description: Success bar copied at fixed offsets (use when success_bar alignment misses because the donor has the app header). Left part of the bar (message) and right part (close X) are copied separately so the bar spans a wider screen. Offsets are numbers, so edit them in a copy of this recipe per use. Values here: Inland AN result grid <- Process success shot (same screen), offset [-2,0] for both parts.

inputs.screen: screenshot that should show the bar
inputs.donor: screenshot with the green success bar
inputs.left: x0,y0,x1,y1 of the left part of the bar in the DONOR
inputs.right: x0,y0,x1,y1 of the right part of the bar in the DONOR
